messages:
oncall_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for model text-icedge-v1q in us-west. Error rate 3.2% over 5m (baseline ~0.1%). Paging @eli and @marta.
eli: I'm on it. Which variant is the canary?
marta: v1q is the quantized canary; v1-stable is the safe variant. Seeing p50 -> 210ms, p95 -> 1.2s on v1q, and 502/504s in logs.
priya: Customer impact? Any specific API keys spiking errors? @tanvi_cs?
tanvi_cs: Pebble and Nova logs show retries/failures, ~4 customers with visible errors. CS is triaging and collecting request ids.
eli: Plan: cut traffic to v1q (weight=0), shift to v1-stable, and apply emergency per-key throttles for the heaviest callers. Who can run routing commands?
marta: I can. Running: 
```
# cut traffic from quantized canary
redwoodctl routes update --model text-icedge --variant v1q --weight 0 --reason "emergency disable canary"
# shift to stable
redwoodctl routes update --model text-icedge --variant v1-stable --weight 100
```
priya: Also recommend emergency per-key throttle for top offenders: 1.5 rps per key for 15m. Command:
```
redwoodctl quotas emergency --keys-file /tmp/top-heavy-keys.txt --limit 1.5 --window 60
```
eli: Doing routing now. Marta, hold until infra confirms.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: route update started for model=text-icedge; job id=job_7723.
eli: Watching rollout, verifying no partial traffic left to v1q.
marta: infra-bot reports success: weights now v1q=0, v1-stable=100.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: route update complete; job id=job_7723; duration=18s.
eli: Observing metrics: overall error rate dropped 3.2% -> 0.4% within 2m. Latency p95 improving to ~420ms.
priya: I'll update status page and notify upstream CS contacts. Tanvi, coordinate messages to Pebble/Nova.
tanvi_cs: On it. CS drafting guidance: retry with exponential backoff, reduce client concurrency for 30m.
marta: Creating incident ticket for rollback/RCAs. Preliminary hypothesis: quantized attention kernel regressed in v1q. Tagging @jamal for analysis.
eli: Applying emergency quotas to top keys now. Running:
```
redwoodctl quotas update --key pebble-pro --limit 1.5
redwoodctl quotas update --key nova-inc --limit 1.5
```
infra-bot: Quotas updated for keys: pebble-pro, nova-inc. job id=job_7724.
eli: Quotas confirmed applied. Monitoring metrics for customer error reduction.
priya: Jamal, any sign of a bad commit?
jamal: Looking through last-night model build logs. Found attention-kernel patch landed into v1q build at 02:12 UTC. I'm pulling the artifact and will trigger a rollback for the canary build.
marta: For now mark incident as mitigated: canary demoted, traffic shifted, quotas in place. We'll monitor for 1h before closing. Handoff scheduled: @eli -> @ana_oncall at 08:00 PT.
eli: I'll watch for 30m then do handoff. Leaving notes in the ticket with commands run and job ids.
priya: Thanks everyone. Keep ticket open until RCA. :thumbsup:
oncall_bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to SEV2. Handoff to ana_oncall at 08:00 PT. Channel will auto-archive in 1h if stable.
nana_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll take the handoff and follow up on RCA with research & ops.
